fact: The November 2018 operational research report states that the Mobile School Report Card (mSRC) is an Android application commissioned by the Ghana Education Service in 2014 with UNICEF support, through which head teachers of public basic schools submit school-level data weekly and termly, including enrolment figures and teacher records; it began in three districts in 2015 and was a pilot in 20 districts covering 1,880 schools by the end of March 2018, and it holds no record per learner.
title: Final Report: Operational Research on Use of Mobile School Report Card (mSRC) as a Management Tool
